messages:
elaine: quick heads-up — noticed the /generate API reference uses a 'files: []' array example but our runtime and SDKs expect a filename->content map (object). This is tripping up integrations and the Go example in the docs PR fails CI.

vikram: which file is the bad example in? openapi.yaml or the examples page? link?

elaine: openapi example under paths./generate.requestBody.content.application/json.example. PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4321 — snippet pasted below.

elaine: ```json
// current incorrect example
{
  "model": "redwood-alpha-1",
  "input": "summarize this",
  "files": [
    {"filename":"notes.txt","content":"..."}
  ]
}
```

elaine: correct shape used by runtime/SDKs is an object keyed by filename: 

```json
{
  "model": "redwood-alpha-1",
  "input": "summarize this",
  "files": {
    "notes.txt": "..."
  }
}
```

marco: thanks, this matches what the Go client expects (map[string]string). We should: 1) fix the OpenAPI example, 2) update Python and Go snippets/examples, 3) add a short migration note for anyone relying on the array shape. I'll pick up 2 + add a test snippet in docs/examples/.

sam: can we also add a runtime-friendly error if array arrives (400 with clear message)? or a graceful migration fallback? Otherwise people hitting the old example will get obscure errors.

elaine: filed a follow-up ticket INF-987 for graceful acceptance/fallback; I added a short migration note in the PR description recommending converting arrays to objects.

sam: perfect. I'll add a quick validation error message change ("files must be an object keyed by filename") as part of INF-987 and prioritize it next sprint.

elaine: added a curl example in the PR too: 

```bash
curl -X POST 
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" 
  -d '{"model":"redwood-alpha-1","input":"x","files":{"a.txt":"stuff"}}' 
  https://api.redwood.ai/generate
```

doc-bot: PR 4321 — docs lint: passed. link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4321/checks :white_check_mark:

vikram: LGTM from docs POV. assigning @marco to update SDK snippets and @sam to follow up on runtime validation/fallback.

marco: I'll update the Go snippet and add a python snippet variant. ETA: today EOD. I'll also add a short unit test for the examples folder.

sam: I'll scope the runtime change; full fallback will need careful backwards-compat review. For now I'll ensure we produce a friendly 400 message and link to migration note.

elaine: thanks! one more ask — can we add a brief migration note under "Breaking changes" in the next docs deploy so external users see it? I've pinged @release in the PR.

sam: will add to release notes draft. :thumbsup:

elaine: merging the docs PR once marco pushes the snippet updates. will re-run checks and follow up on INF-987 after that.

marco: sending the snippet commit now.

doc-bot: commit 9a7c3f pushed to PR 4321, lint re-run: passed.

elaine: great, thanks everyone.
